description: Dialect gold set for the cue matcher behind POST /api/phrase-eval and POST /api/dialect/analyze (lib/dialect.ts inferDialectFromText; suggestion floor 0.58, curated-region floor 0.75, scoring capped at 2000 chars). Gate entries must keep passing; probe entries record true labels the current 19-phrase / 11-label catalog cannot yet resolve and never fail the run. Baselines were measured against the real matcher on 2026-11-11 (W6) and deliberately re-baselined at integration for the W1 romanized view + curated regions; refresh them deliberately when the catalog or floors change.
measured: 2026-11-11 via inferDialectFromText (cue_match only), re-measured at integration after W1 (romanized view, curated regions, input cap)
